claim: The canonical POS line can say its price is unknown: CanonicalItem.price in apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-types.ts is declared number | null. Until it is, an adapter must write a number for a line whose POS gave no price, and writes 0, so public.pos_item_sales (PR #712) adds the line to sales at 0 instead of counting it unreadable (tech-debt.d/2026-11-01-fix-pos-lines-carry-unit-price.md, first entry; OD-244 option (b) needs it). Holds once the type allows null.
